title: Tua Tagovailoa takes part in Thursday's practice

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Tua Tagovailoa takes part in Thursday's practice
sources.description: Falcons quarterback Tua Tagovailoa missed the first practice of training camp with back tightness, but head coach Kevin Stefanski said that he didn't expect it to be a lengthy absence and his prediction was proven correct on Thursday.
